attributes.summary: v0.3.1 node velocities with the solid surface (medium: water Vp 1.5 km/s, air NaN above the D-B068 merged surface; v0.3.1 values kept as Vp_tomography, Vs_tomography) and the D-B073 shallow oceanic crust rule at the rock nodes (Vs <= Vp/2.1 within 2.5 km below the seafloor offshore); NonLinLoc grids = the exact v5.1 production fields (time_b4_v0.3.1m_sc21: v0.3.1 + field-level D-B073 on the 1 km lattice). Three-dimensional Vp and Vs of the Cascadia margin and Juan de Fuca / Gorda plates from double-difference local-earthquake tomography (tomoDD-SE) of the offshore-onshore ensemble catalog (OBS and land picks), on the tomoDD node grid (interior nodes). Depth in km below sea level, positive down.
attributes.provenance_start_model: D-B005 x (1 + change of margin_m0_v2/d200_s480) at each tile's nodes
attributes.provenance_nll_grids: exact v5.1 production fields (work_time_b4_v0.3.1m_sc21): b4_time_grids.build_field(v0.3.1 nodes, 1 km, merged mask, field-level D-B073), md5 checked against the production work fields
attributes.merge_rules: D-B049 resolution-gated merge V = R V_tiles + (1 - R) V_ref; D-B050 excluded tiles; D-B051 Vs reverted to the reference where Vp/Vs < vpvs_min or dws_s < dws_s_min
attributes.surface_rule: D-B068 merged solid surface: D-B068 merged solid surface (b4_surface.surface_m, bilinear on the first covering source: GMRT patches, earth_relief 01m elsewhere) sampled at the node; 0 rock (depth >= -surface_elevation), 1 water (above the surface, depth >= 0), 2 air (above the surface, depth < 0): the test of the production field cells; water Vp 1.5 km/s (D-B005), Vs NaN; air NaN

attributes.shallow_crust_rule: D-B073 at the nodes (2-km-node approximation of the field rule): rock nodes (medium 0) in offshore columns (coast-scan mask of b4_time_grids.offshore_mask on the 1 km Lambert lattice of the production field, coast_run_km 5, cuts [[47.9, 48.75, -124.55], [46.1, 46.4, -124.05]], taken at the lattice column containing the node), below sea level and at most 2.5 km below the merged seafloor sampled at the node (depth + surface_elevation <= 2.5): Vs = min(Vs_tomography, Vp_tomography / 2.1). Nodes above the seafloor are water (no rule). The NonLinLoc grids carry the exact field rule (cell centres of the 1 km lattice)
attributes.shallow_crust_node_note: the node values carry a 2-km-node approximation of the rule; the NonLinLoc grids (v0.3.2_nll) carry the exact field rule that the v5.1 relocation used; read_velocity_model.py evaluates the field rule at any point from v0.3.2_surface_lattice.nc
attributes.nll_frame: Earth-flattened, cell-centred SLOW_LEN on the 1 km D-B005 Lambert lattice: depth axis z' = Re ln(Re / (Re - z)), velocity v' = v Re / (Re - z), Re = 6371 km (as the v5.1 travel-time grids)
